scope: Current manual plan after recovery of accepted historical art; not a historical generator input.
selected_source_policy: Preserve accepted intrinsic cat silhouette and physical scale, derive one common canvas/pivot. No named gear, mutation appendages or new whole-body redraw.
palette_interpretation: Native m coat and y pale secondary areas. Muzzle/chest bib follows the actual named/generic pale front pattern. Existing sparse bright glass-fiber strokes supply small secondary highlights; their precise placement is authored, not decoded anatomy. No new eyes, spots or emitted light.

per_view.south: Compact feline faces south. Head/ears and front muzzle are low/front; tail rises behind rump above torso. Fore paws near contact; hind pair naturally hidden. Pale muzzle/chest and a few existing glass strokes.
per_view.east: Whole right profile, head right and tail rooted at left rump. Two near paws read at contact, far pair naturally overlaps. Head/neck cut above foreleg; no paw becomes part of head. Pale muzzle/chest is anterior.
per_view.north: Back of head/ears only, no face. Tail root connects lower rump and curves outside right flank, with gap from skull. Rear paws visible, fore pair occluded. Front bib/muzzle hidden; only sparse existing glass strokes.
per_view.west: Exact mirrored east body/head/tint geometry, one mirror at output. Source markings have no established fixed laterality; no independent bounds fitting.

chronology: Historical front and front-guided side/back plus corrected north were recovered byte-exact. Current editable geometry documents anatomy/ownership and registration; it is not falsely labeled as an input to those past calls.
